name: print-social-pixel-retro-product-ui-styleguide-poster
title: Pixel Retro Product UI Styleguide Poster
whatItIs: A cream poster in pixel type titled 'PRODUCT UI STYLEGUIDE' with dotted-rule sections for colour tokens, typography scale, spacing, radius, elevation layers, buttons, inputs, chips, tabs, alerts and cards, in black, greys and neon green.
whatItMeans: Retro pixel styling makes a dry spec feel like a game manual, while neon green marks the primary actions.
techniques: Dotted leader lines after section titles
Chunky black outlines on every component
Neon green as the only saturated colour

vocabulary.definition: Named values for colour, spacing and type used across a system.
Steps of visual height shown by stacked planes.
Lettering built from visible square pixels.
